hypothesis: Six rules that were built in shadow in M15 each carry a direction. For each rule, the mean market-adjusted return of its flagged events, taken in the stated direction, is beyond zero. Each rule is its own lineage with one look at its own n. A pass is recorded for the CTX-053 path only; no rule, gate, weight or status changes.
market_rule: each market is counted and tested on its own forward record; a lineage and its plan are per market
return_rule: market-adjusted return = the stock's simple return over the window minus the benchmark index's simple return over the same window; no costs unless the rule says net
counter: events whose whole horizon has already elapsed (a calendar count by session dates, made before any outcome is read); the look needs this count to reach the rule's n
interval: one-sided 90 % lower bound of the mean in the stated direction (the 0.10 quantile of 2000 stationary block-bootstrap replicate means resampled by session, expected block = the rule's horizon in sessions, seeded per rule); for a difference rule, the same bound of the difference of the two group means
pass_rule: PASS when the lower bound of the direction-signed statistic is above zero; NULL when it is not; INCONCLUSIVE and spent when the statistic cannot be computed (an undefined bootstrap)
below_n: INCONCLUSIVE: no look is taken and no outcome is used; the plan stays frozen and the one look waits for the night the count reaches n; events whose prices are missing are left out, and if fewer than n remain nothing is written
consequence: a PASS is recorded for the CTX-053 path, shadow first; a NULL keeps the rule in shadow; nothing here changes a gate or a rule

rules.name: halt-resume block
rules.event: a trading halt of a watch with expected sign zero or negative has resumed (one event per code and halt)
rules.outcome: market-adjusted return from the open of the resume session to the close of the fifth session counting the resume session as the first; the index leg is its open on the first session to its close on the fifth

rules.name: results window
rules.event: a gate-eight pass of a Cortex family (first session of the pass, one event per code and session); inside the results window or outside it
rules.outcome: net return from the fill over 20 sessions in parts per million of the fill value, minus the benchmark index return over the same sessions
rules.n_note: at least 60 passes inside the window and at least 60 outside (a difference needs both sides)
rules.reader: none until a stored forward record of the window note exists

rules.name: volume creep
rules.event: a code-day flagged by the volume-creep angle at its default grid point (ar_min_pct=2,vr_min=3), one event per code and day
rules.outcome: market-adjusted close-to-close return from the flag day to the close of the tenth session after it

rules.name: short risk
rules.event: a code-day flagged for short-selling risk, one event per code and day
rules.outcome: market-adjusted close-to-close return from the flag day to the close of the twentieth session after it
rules.reader: none until a stored forward record of the flag exists

rules.name: young listings
rules.event: a Cortex setup that used the young-listing grid point (60 to 251 sessions of history), one event per code and session
rules.outcome: net return from the fill over 20 sessions in parts per million of the fill value, minus the benchmark index return over the same sessions
rules.reader: none until a stored forward record of the grid point used exists

rules.name: sector composite
rules.event: an intraday candidate with a sector-adjusted move; the side is above zero or at or below zero
rules.outcome: the candidate's recorded excess return from the next open to the close of that session against the benchmark index
rules.direction: above-zero side minus at-or-below side above zero
rules.n_note: at least 60 candidates on each side
